item.title: Factors Beyond Skin Symptoms Shape Body Image in Psoriasis
item.description: Body image issues can persist beyond visible skin lesions, with fatigue, functional limitations, mood symptoms, and nail involvement also playing a role.

item.title: General Anesthesia More Common in Urgent C-Sections
item.description: General anesthesia is used more often in urgent cesarean deliveries than in elective cases, with wide variation across European countries, a study finds.

item.title: Canada's Safe Social Media Act Prioritizes Child Health
item.description: Canada's proposed Safe Social Media Act, aimed at protecting children, should be passed, according to an analysis article in CMAJ.

item.title: Evolving Cells Help Pancreatic Cancer Evade Treatment and Spread
item.description: An analysis of nearly half a million cells from dozens of patients' tumors shows how cancer cells continuously reshape their genetic makeup over time.
